C2 (DB1, corroborated by CA1 as W1): the M06 finalize scope upgrade rebuilt the job's normalization policy from dictionary skills alone, silently dropping the frozen manifest skills on every site/workspace-resolving destination (ai_prompt exactly) while the envelope still claimed the registry — AC03 break with contradictory provenance.
